verdict.rationale: Unity is not itself an AI agent but a game engine/platform, so the axis applies; docs describe an official MCP server that connects LLM-based agents like Claude Code and Cursor to the Unity Editor via standardized MCP tools, corroborated by a probe confirming the get-started documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification of the MCP server working in practice and details on its production maturity/stability.
